coverage: Exact current Caddy identity and only unambiguous verified courses-staging web/s3 endpoints.
Backup reload requires both observed live snapshots to remain exactly old or candidate; otherwise manual recovery and lock are retained.
Host and container-mounted file device/inode/nlink plus SHA must agree before private state writes or network creation/connection. BusyBox stat %d is interpreted as decimal, not %D hexadecimal.
New directory sync followed by parent sync; real private file write/fsync followed by directory sync; journal/receipt rename followed by destination and distinct source directory sync.
Synthetic local filesystem verifies entry/byte visibility and synchronization callback ordering; failures propagate.
limitations: No helper CLI invocation, real Docker/Caddy network change, reload or rollback execution.

Actual Linux directory fsync, uid/gid 1001 ownership, and live bind identity have not been exercised. Windows local tests use synchronization callbacks for directories while real files are created/written/fsynced/renamed inside .runtime and cleaned within a checked absolute target.
Canonical live GET comparisons followed by Caddy reload are not an atomic compare-and-swap. An exclusive operator window remains mandatory.
Durability mechanisms reduce crash exposure but do not implement automatic crash recovery; retained journal/backups/lock require operator review.
